column3: Close to the Greek; “the Most High” is rendered “the Highest.”
NKJV has “with God nothing will be impossible”; the Greek reads literally “every word will not be impossible with God.”
Close to the Greek; “from where to me this” is rendered “why is this granted to me.”
NKJV has “from generation to generation,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to generations and generations.”
